description: North Central Province Provincial Council - 05th Session of the North Central Province Provincial Council came to end in 09.12.2016 & 6th Session will meet on 31.01.2017
categorisation: This gazette content contains a declaration by the Provincial Governor regarding the conclusion of one session and the convening of the next session of the North Central Provincial Council. This falls under electoral and parliamentary processes at the provincial level, specifically covering the scheduling and timing of council sessions, which aligns with Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) for matters related to electoral processes and legislative body operations.
